@@U04167@@
The right flank’s holding up well; and there I see the giant Jack 好斗者 towering above all the rest, doing what he does best.

@@U04169@@
First I saw only one arm raised in battle, now I see a dozen; it’s not natural.

@@U04171@@
Have you never heard of the streaks of mist that sweep the coast of Sicily? Shimmering in the bright light of day, they rise to the middle air and there present wondrous visions mirrored in their own peculiar haze. Cities are seen swaying this way and that, and gardens rising and falling, as image follows image, appearing, vanishing.

@@U04173@@
Look there! How very strange! What’s that light at the tips of my soldiers’ lances? And flames dancing on the polished spears of our phalanx! I find it all very mysterious.

@@U04175@@
By your leave, Sire, those are the traces of spirits now long vanished, the Dioskouroi, that sailors always swear by, summoning here the last of their strength.

@@U04177@@
But why should Nature come to aid us with her most precious gifts?
translation:
@@U04167@@
右翼支撑良好；在那里，我看到了巨人杰克·好斗者，他高高在上，做着他最擅长的事。

@@U04169@@
起初我只看到一只手臂在战斗中举起，现在我看到了十几只手臂；这不自然。

@@U04171@@
您从未听说过席卷西西里岛海岸的薄雾吗？它们在白天的明亮光线下闪闪发光，升到半空中，在它们自己独特的薄雾中呈现出奇妙的景象。城市左右摇曳，花园起伏，就像图像接着图像一样，出现、消失。

@@U04173@@
看那儿！多么奇怪啊！我的士兵长矛尖上的那道光是什么？火焰在我们方阵抛光的长矛上舞动！我觉得这一切都很神秘。

@@U04175@@
陛下，请您原谅，这些是早已消失的灵魂的痕迹，Dioskouroi，水手们总是发誓的，在这里召唤他们最后的力量。

@@U04177@@
但大自然为什么要用她最珍贵的礼物来帮助我们呢？
